features.quote: 40 tool turns or 80k cumulative tokens, whichever first.
compute online repetition score … If similarity >0.85 for 4 consecutive turns, mark `degraded=true (loop)` programmatically and kill the run.
features.justification_quote: Saves ~30–40% of tokens; the marginal turns carry no information once a loop is confirmed.

features.quote: Run-length cap as policy, not just cost: once degradation is programmatically confirmed there is no measurement value in letting a model churn through 25 more turns of self-critical looping — terminate early as a matter of course.
